name: Monastery of the Hieronymites and Tower of Belém in Lisbon
description: At the mouth of the Tagus in Lisbon's Belém district, two landmarks recall Portugal's Age of Discoveries. The Hieronymites Monastery, begun in 1502, is a showpiece of Portuguese craftsmanship. Nearby, the 30-metre Tower of Belém, built of pale limestone with Moorish-style turrets, once welcomed explorers home and greeted ships arriving in the city.
